verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that 2FAS Auth generates TOTP codes on iOS and Android and is positioned as an easy way to enable 2FA, with video tutorials for connecting accounts. However, no evidence explicitly describes QR-code scanning or the immediate scan-to-code onboarding flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of QR-code scanning to add an account, evidence that codes are generated immediately after scanning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the add-account flow.
